parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: The outside frame of the door set, made of wood, providing structural support and alignment for the door.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the door in place and provides the boundary for the door to open and close properly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during door operation.

parts.name: Hinge
parts.Basic_description: A steel hinge connecting the door to the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the door to pivot open and closed smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its pin axis to enable door movement.

parts.Basic_description: The main door panel made of wood with glass inserts, forming the movable part of the door set.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the barrier that opens and closes to allow or restrict access through the doorway.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the hinges to open or close relative to the frame.
